This newly opened spot on Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai Street, just a short walk from the U.S. Consulate, delivers a truly traditional Northern-style Bún Chả experience.

First off, the hygiene? Spotless. Everything was super clean, and the restaurant itself had this really nice, modern design and a great vibe, especially compared to the usual crowded spots around here. You could tell they really cared about the quality.

The grilled pork was delicious, the pickled papaya had a delightful crispness, and the fish sauce was perfectly balanced, avoiding the excessive saltiness found in many other establishments. Everything tasted fresh and thoughtfully prepared.

Although the serving speed was a little slow, it's completely understandable considering it was their first day of operation.

This restaurant, a hidden gem in the city, offers authentic Bún Chả, and it's definitely worth checking out.
